diagnosis: Benign epithelial melanosis of the conjunctiva
legend: The conjunctival epithelium is pigmented, with some melanophages present in the substantia propria as well. Melanocytes, however, appear normal.

diagnosis: Benign epithelial melanosis of the conjunctiva
legend: A melan-A (MART1) immunostain confirms normal density of dendritic-appearing melanocytes.

diagnosis: Benign epithelial melanosis of the conjunctiva
legend: Top Abnormal pigmentation of the conjunctiva at the superior and temporal limbus with extension into the bulbar conjunctiva is seen. Prominent striate melanokeratosis is present throughout the cornea extending into the visual axis. Middle There is secondary pigmentation of the basilar keratinocytes and an epithelial inclusion cyst in the substantia propria. Bottom There is secondary pigmentation in the basilar keratinocytes in the epithelial inclusion cyst.
